_: Example file for the wizard's Import-from-file feature.
_about: This is the 'wizard-session' JSON shape — the same format the wizard
POSTs back to /api/session, what /api/template/<name> returns, and what
you save by clicking 'Save session as JSON' inside the wizard.
Drop this file on the wizard's Step 1 'Import from file' card. The
• Warnings:    0   (every entity has a description, base IRI is set)
• Suggestions: 0   (no PII columns; sensitivity tiers already set)
Click 'Accept & replace session' to hydrate the wizard with a
ready-to-generate Smart Building Operations domain — 6 entities,
Underscore-prefixed keys (_, _about) are silently ignored by the
validator — keep them or strip them, your choice.

domain.name: Smart Building Operations
domain.description: Real-time sensing, HVAC control, occupancy tracking, and maintenance ticketing across a portfolio of commercial smart buildings.

entities.name: building
entities.label: Building
entities.description: A physical building in the portfolio with an address, gross floor area, and certification level.

entities.name: floor
entities.label: Floor
entities.description: A floor within a Building, identified by floor number and tenant zoning.

entities.name: room
entities.label: Room
entities.description: A leasable or service space on a Floor (office, meeting room, plant room, etc.).

entities.name: sensor
entities.label: Sensor
entities.description: A physical sensor (temperature, CO2, occupancy, door state, light level) installed in a Room.

entities.name: hvac_unit
entities.label: HVAC Unit
entities.description: A heating/ventilation/air-conditioning unit serving one or more Floors.

entities.name: tenant
entities.label: Tenant
entities.description: An organisation leasing one or more Rooms in a Building. Marked Confidential because lease terms and contact information are commercially sensitive.

events.name: temperature_reading
events.label: Temperature Reading
events.description: An observation event — a temperature sample produced by a Sensor at a point in time.

events.name: maintenance_ticket
events.label: Maintenance Ticket
events.description: A work item raised against an HVAC Unit, Sensor, or Room with a severity and assigned engineer.

competency_questions.question: Which rooms are currently above their temperature setpoint?
Which HVAC units have open critical maintenance tickets?
Which sensors have not produced a reading in the last 30 minutes?
Which tenants occupy rooms with abnormal occupancy patterns this week?
What is the average occupancy of each floor by hour of day?
